svg.title: Agentic Core — AWS Target Architecture
svg.desc: Proposed junior Solutions Architect design case study. AWS resources have not been deployed or cloud runtime validation performed.
svg.text: Governed workflow engineering | One workload account | Seven logical scopes share managed services
Query pending intent / reclaim expired relay lease
Bounded replay of unresolved event IDs
Read exact bytes; report to Core
PIC = shared reviewed code: approval · ownership · permission scope · verification · bounded repair · release.
k = 2 total candidate attempts. Core mediates all phases; owner acceptance is required before release.
IAM roles · CloudWatch telemetry · audit/retention policies. Managed-service baseline; no customer VPC.
DESIGN CASE STUDY | AWS RUNTIME VALIDATION PENDING
